history.title: History and traditions
history.subtitle: From Skovoroda's educational imperatives to a contemporary quality policy in education, research, and international cooperation.
history.intro1: The development of H. S. Skovoroda Kharkiv National Pedagogical University rests on the continuous improvement of teaching, research, innovation, and civic education, responding to society's needs and preparing in-demand educators and scholars. The university positions itself as an educational, research, and cultural centre that shapes competent, spiritually rich teachers who are patriots and engaged citizens of Ukraine.
history.intro2: Historical experience aligns with the Magna Charta Universitatum, respect for human rights, and Ukraine's national interests. The university's policy multiplies civilisational advances in education, spreads pedagogical culture, and pursues a humanistic educational ideal under the motto “Education will save Ukraine!”

1804.title: Identity and tradition
1804.text: Our roots lie in Skovoroda's tradition of education and enlightenment, the Ukrainian national idea, and building an educational space for civil society.

1851.title: Autonomy and governance
1851.text: The university favours autonomy and self-government, distinguishes rights from responsibilities clearly, and combines collegiality with the ability to provide unified leadership.

1921.title: Quality and continuity
1921.text: We prioritise depth of learning, continuity of education and scholarship, integrating teaching, development, and upbringing, while steadily improving programmes and methods.

1991.title: International openness
1991.text: Active integration into global educational and research communities, with broader ties and exchange programmes with leading universities in Ukraine, Europe, and worldwide.

2004.title: Innovation and inclusion
2004.text: Contemporary methods and technologies, environmental awareness, an open inclusive environment, and support for the talents of everyone involved in learning.

2022.title: Today's strategic priorities
2022.text: Focus on high-quality learner preparation, research schools, internationalisation, academic integrity, a quality culture, and a united Skovoroda community.

mission.title: Mission, vision, and values
mission.subtitle: The university motto is “Education will save Ukraine!” Its core meanings are set out in the quality policy and reflect the path of the Skovoroda community.
mission.missionText1: We prepare teachers and professionals who embody the Ukrainian national idea, think in innovative ways, conduct research, and carry out educational outreach grounded in national philosophy of education, pedagogy, psychology, culture, and the social sciences, humanities, and natural sciences.
mission.missionText2: The mission is to build an educational space and strengthen civil society in Ukraine through high-quality fundamental and professional preparation at every level of higher education and by nurturing responsible agents of change.
mission.visionText1: As one of the leaders in education, research, and innovation in Slobozhanshchyna, H. S. Skovoroda Kharkiv National Pedagogical University delivers teacher education and outreach in new formats on the basis of broad European and global integration.
mission.visionText2: The university actively contributes to the intellectual, spiritual, and socio-economic development of the country and society, pairing the preservation of Ukrainian educational traditions with contemporary innovative approaches.
mission.valuesText1: Traditions built over the university's history sustain a distinct identity and a strong academic community. Together they form the value system that guides us in teaching, research, and the development of every member of the Skovoroda family.
mission.valuesText2: Below are the key principles that shape our culture of cooperation, responsibility, and commitment to high standards across all areas of university life.

integrity.title: Academic integrity
integrity.text: Honesty, integrity, and responsibility in learning, teaching, and research: adherence to ethical standards and the law as the foundation of academic culture.

openness.title: Openness
openness.text: Democracy and collegiality in decision-making, transparency in governance, and free exchange of knowledge and ideas within the university community.

respect.title: Respect and equality
respect.text: A human-centred approach: respect for dignity and rights, support for diversity, an inclusive environment, and dialogue among cultures.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: High-quality educational practice, adoption of contemporary methods and technologies, critical thinking, and continuous improvement of programmes.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: The Skovoroda community of students, faculty, and researchers united by shared goals; growing international cooperation and mutual support.

heritage.title: Heritage preservation
heritage.text: Patriotism and multiculturalism: esteem for Ukrainian cultural heritage and openness to cooperation and mutual learning among peoples.

erasmus.title: Erasmus+ programmes
erasmus.subtitle: Academic exchanges, traineeships and international cooperation under Erasmus+.
erasmus.intro: The EU Erasmus+ programme supports semester-based study abroad, staff training periods, and joint university projects. At KhNPU initiatives include Key Action 1 — international mobility for credit — and Key Action 2 partnerships, including dedicated capacity-building projects. One active example is «Embedding leading European competencies in teacher-training standards for Ukraine's resilience» (LECTURE‑101179602). In spring 2026 a university delegation undertook a mobility visit to the University of the Balearic Islands (Spain) and concluded a cooperation agreement; details are coordinated by the Centre for International Activity.

capacity.text: Strategic partnerships and multi-year projects that jointly develop curricula, research, and events between universities.

step1.title: Verify requirements
step1.text: Read the competition notice, confirm language prerequisites, and check that an agreement exists with your chosen partner within Erasmus+.

step2.title: Submit your application
step2.text: Collect documents (motivation letter, study plan, references if requested) and apply to the Centre for International Activity by the prescribed deadline.

step3.title: Selection outcome
step3.text: The university commission evaluates applications and endorses nominees to sign learning agreements and continue grant procedures.

step4.title: Departure preparation
step4.text: After signing Grant Agreement documentation and Learning Agreement forms you receive visa, insurance, and logistics support ahead of departure.

master.subtitle: Second cycle of higher education: in-depth specialisation and research skills.
master.intro: Master admission requires registering for the foreign-language Unified Entrance Exam (UEE) and the unified professional entrance assessment (UPEA) between 23 April and 14 May 2026 per Ukraine's national entrants' testing schedule (follow current instructions on testportal.gov.ua and Ministry of Education and Science notices). Electronic applications proceed through https://vstup.edbo.gov.ua.
master.researchText: Master's programmes deepen subject mastery and consolidate research competencies: advanced seminars, elective blocks, internships, and a qualification project or thesis according to Ukrainian higher-education standards.

graduate.title: Graduate school and doctorate

graduate.intro: Postgraduate admissions are supervised by KhNPU Postgraduate Studies and Doctorate Office — today enrolling 300+ PhD candidates across ten specialties and roughly 17 doctoral students. phd.title: Doctoral programme (PhD)

doctoral.title: Doctor of Sciences studies

exams.title: Exam programmes

exams.intro: In 2026 prospective bachelor students gain places using the National Multi‑Subject Test (NMT). Topic programmes are approved by UCESAO («Annex 9» to each institution's Rules). Master's applicants take the foreign-language Unified Entrance Exam (online) plus the unified professional entrance assessment (UPEA) for their field. Doctoral (PhD) applicants sit the foreign-language exam and special subject exam. Official entrance examination programmes are annexed to «Rules of admission… 2026» and circulated by Admissions for each intake.

benefits.title: Benefits and social support
benefits.subtitle: Statutory guarantees and support for different student categories.
benefits.intro: State guarantees, quotas, and preferential admission are governed by Ukrainian Law «On Higher Education» plus Cabinet and Ministry regulations. KhNPU applies quota 1 (separate budget seats for legally defined benefit groups) and quota 2 (including internally displaced persons, combat veterans, and applicants from temporarily occupied territories). Document checklists, verification, and admission priorities are listed in KhNPU «Rules of admission… 2026» and clarified by the Admissions committee (contacts on this site's Contacts page).
benefits.orphans: Orphans and children deprived of parental care
benefits.orphansDesc: Verified status typically enables competition on quota‑1 budget seats with continued social protections after matriculation.
benefits.largeFamiliesDesc: Eligibility for state support and social benefits follows national law; the university advises on scholarships and dormitory access once supporting documents are filed.
benefits.disabilityDesc: Students with disabilities (Groups I–II) and learners with special educational needs may compete under quota‑1 where medical and psycho-pedagogical documentation supports the request.
benefits.warAffectedDesc: Internally displaced persons and related war‑affected categories use quota‑2 together with special procedures for temporarily occupied territories (interviews, Donbas-Ukraine / Crimea-Ukraine education centre support) per Rules and MES notices.
benefits.lowIncomeDesc: Social scholarships depend on official income and household composition certificates processed through the social office after enrolment.
benefits.academicExcellenceDesc: Strong NMT results and competition scores improve budget chances; additional academic scholarships follow collective agreements and university regulations.
benefits.step1Text: Gather the document set required for your benefit category as listed by the admissions office.
benefits.step2Text: Documents are accepted by the university social service and the admissions office.
benefits.step3Text: After verification you will receive confirmation of your right to benefits or social scholarship.

veterans.title: Veterans and applicants from temporarily occupied territories
veterans.subtitle: Donbas–Ukraine / Crimea–Ukraine education centre: tailored admission support for combat veterans, their families, and entrants from TOT.
veterans.intro: KhNPU hosts the Donbas–Ukraine / Crimea–Ukraine education centre supporting applicants from temporarily occupied territories (TOT). Persons who lived on TOT or relocated after 1 October 2025 may enter without the NMT via university interview. Earlier departures still require NMT scores but can access quota‑2 budget seats. Partner secondary credentials are issued by the «Obdarovanist» boarding lyceum (state-recognised upper-secondary certificate).

privacy.p1: The controller of personal data processed through official KhNPU websites and web forms is H. S. Skovoroda Kharkiv National Pedagogical University. Contact channels published in the “Contacts” section apply to general governance matters.
privacy.p2: We process personal data that you voluntarily submit (for example, application forms, feedback messages, or profile data when you sign in to the personal account) and technical server logs required to keep the service secure and reliable.
privacy.p3: Purposes include handling admissions and study administration, responding to correspondence, meeting transparency duties, and protecting information systems. Data are kept only as long as required by law or internal retention rules applicable to educational archives.
privacy.p4: Under Ukrainian law on personal data protection you may request access, rectification, restriction, or deletion where no statutory retention applies. Submit requests in writing through official university channels so staff can verify identity.
privacy.p5: This statement may be updated when legal requirements or services change. Continued use of the site after updates means you accept the revised text.

feedback.cardGeneralBody: Call the main university line during published hours or write to the rectorate mailbox for formal correspondence.
feedback.cardAdmissionsBody: Competition lists, document submission, and entrance exams are handled exclusively by the admissions office. See the dedicated page for direct contacts.

admissionsEdebo.title: Applicant e-cabinet (EDEBO)
admissionsEdebo.subtitle: Electronic applications for bachelor's, master's, and postgraduate places are lodged in the Unified State Electronic Database on Education administered by Ukraine's Ministry of Education and Science.
admissionsEdebo.intro: EDEBO (vstup.edbo.gov.ua) is the only official gateway for declaring entrance priorities, uploading electronic dossiers where required, confirming offers, and monitoring competition lists. Universities cannot bypass this national ledger for statutory admission cycles.
admissionsEdebo.stepSecureBody: Create EDEBO using your own identifiers. Never disclose one-time passwords; treat offers and confirmations only inside the authenticated cabinet.
admissionsEdebo.stepDeadlinesBody: Applicants arrange up to seven competitive offers per tier following the Procedure for admission endorsed each year by the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine and instructions from KhNPU. Missing a deadline in EDEBO cannot be undone through university email alone.
admissionsEdebo.stepDocsBody: Electronic submission speeds up queues, but originals or duly certified copies are still inspected per programme rules—watch messages from EDEBO and the admissions desk.
admissionsEdebo.stepSupportBody: Use KhNPU's admissions committee contacts before policy disputes arise—official interpretations of competition lists are anchored in statutory rules.
admissionsEdebo.openPortal: Open EDEBO in a new tab
admissionsEdebo.monHub: Cabinet-approved admission procedure and methodological letters are published centrally on the Ministry of Education and Science portal.
